title: Korean-Style Wrinkled Tagine Stew
description: A flavorful and hearty vegetarian stew made with wrinkled potatoes, korean chili flakes, and tagine spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in chili flakes, cumin, and tagine spice blend. Cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add diced potatoes, chickpeas, and 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
